svg.title: The dark side of the Internet — study visual
svg.desc: Study guide covering hackers, crackers, smurfing, viruses, ransomware, spam, and phishing
svg.text: The dark side of the Internet

g.text: Public, open, not perfectly safe. New tech → new criminal opportunities.
Penetrating a system. Once done, a hacker reports it to makers; a cracker exploits it.
Attacks NOT sent from phisher's computer → hired person controls a network of thousands of machines

svg.text: Unit 3 · The dark side of the Internet
